title: Canonical derived constant-tower evaluation and exact-functor comparison
statement:
Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian]. Put $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal E)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal E)$ for $\mathcal E=\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ [def-weil-inverse-system], and choose the ordinary unbounded derived categories of $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A),\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal B)$, with independent morphism universe bounds [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $C_{\mathcal E}:\mathcal E\to\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal E)$ be the constant functor and $E_n^{\mathcal E}:\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal E)\to\mathcal E$ evaluation at positive level $n$. Package the additive structure [def-weil-pbc-additive-functor] of $C_{\mathcal E}$ by its preservation of binary products. For an additive exact functor $G$ (preserving finite limits and finite colimits [def-galois-exact-functor]), write $D(G)$ for its termwise localization, $c(G,H):D(H\circ G)\xrightarrow{\sim}D(H)\circ D(G)$ for the canonical composition comparison, and $\iota_{\mathcal E}:D(\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal E})\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}_{D(\mathcal E)}$ for the identity comparison. Write $D(\alpha)$ for the localized isomorphism induced by an ordinary natural isomorphism $\alpha$. Define the canonical constant-tower evaluation by the composite
$$s_n^{\mathcal E}:D(E_n^{\mathcal E})D(C_{\mathcal E})\xrightarrow{c(C_{\mathcal E},E_n^{\mathcal E})^{-1}}D(E_n^{\mathcal E}C_{\mathcal E})\xrightarrow{D(\epsilon_n^{\mathcal E})}D(\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal E})\xrightarrow{\iota_{\mathcal E}}\mathrm{id}_{D(\mathcal E)},$$
where $\epsilon_n^{\mathcal E}:E_n^{\mathcal E}C_{\mathcal E}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal E}$ is the ordinary constant/evaluation identity. For an additive exact functor $F:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$, let $F^{\operatorname{Tow}}$ be postcomposition by $F$ and let $\gamma_F:F^{\operatorname{Tow}}C_{\mathcal B}\xrightarrow{\sim}C_{\mathcal A}F$ be the ordinary identity-component comparison. Define
$$j_F:D(F^{\operatorname{Tow}})D(C_{\mathcal B})\xrightarrow{c(C_{\mathcal B},F^{\operatorname{Tow}})^{-1}}D(F^{\operatorname{Tow}}C_{\mathcal B})\xrightarrow{D(\gamma_F)}D(C_{\mathcal A}F)\xrightarrow{c(F,C_{\mathcal A})}D(C_{\mathcal A})D(F).$$
These are specified composites of the canonical localization comparisons, with natural number index $k$ in Lean representing positive tower level $k+1$.
